Council adopted Ordinance 892 changing the parcel's future land use designation from residential low-density to general commercial.
rows.summary: Mrs. Hamilton motioned to adopt Ordinance 892.

rows.title: Council adopted Ordinance 893 amending the zoning map for the 0.565-acre parcel behind Paradise Shores from residential low density to general commercial.
rows.summary: Mrs. Hamilton motioned to adopt Ordinance 893.

rows.title: The commission voted 3-2 to rebid the project with the same qualifications but a changed scope.
rows.summary: Approval to rebid the project, keeping the qualifications the same but changing the scope.

rows.title: The commission approved accepting an $800,000 state grant for a Stormwater Master Plan through a budget amendment.
rows.summary: Approval of Budget Amendment Resolution 20261013.2 authorizing the City to accept state funded grant for a Stormwater Master Plan in the amount of $800,000.00.

rows.title: Commission accepted a $650,000 state grant for a water storage tank with a $650,000 City match and approved the budget amendment resolution.
rows.summary: Approval of Resolution 20260922.1 authorizing the City to accept a state funded grant for a Water Storage Tank in the amount of $650,000.00 with an additional City match of $650,000.00 and approve Budget Amendment Resolution 20260922.2.

rows.title: The commission directed staff to prepare a budget report for January 12, 2027 and a full exercise for April 13, 2027.
rows.summary: Staff to prepare a report for the January 12, 2027, Commission Meeting, and full exercise for the April 13, 2027, Commission Meeting, for an adoptable budget in accordance with Statute 166.2411 3B.

rows.title: The commission approved a budget amendment allocating reimbursement revenue to division expense accounts.
rows.summary: Approval of Budget Amendment Resolution 20261013.3 for the Allocation of Reimbursement Revenue to the Division Expense Accounts.

rows.title: The commission waived special event and police fees of $5,220 for the 2026 Bay County Veteran's Day Parade and the fees for 2027.
rows.summary: Approval to waive all applicable Special Event and Police Fees for Bay County Veteran's Day Parade, November 11, 2026, in the amount of $5,220.00 and waive the fees for year 2027.

rows.title: The commission approved a budget amendment resolution and a $2,000.86 increase to the T K Vandy LLC contract.
rows.summary: Approval of Budget Amendment Resolution 20261013.1 and to increase the existing contract with T K Vandy LLC, by $2,000.86.

rows.title: The board approved the Professional Services Committee's architect selection for the Mowat Renovations Project.
rows.summary: Motion to approve the Professional Services Committee Architect Selection for the Mowat Renovations Project

rows.title: The board approved the 27-05 ITB award for landscaping.
rows.summary: Motion to approve the 27-05 ITB Award – Landscaping

rows.title: The board approved the request to purchase content filtering software.
rows.summary: Motion to approve the Request to Purchase Content Filtering Software

rows.title: The commission voted to delay the final reading of Ordinance 3319 to the November 17, 2026 meeting.
rows.summary: Approval to delay the final reading of Ordinance 3319 to the November 17, 2026, Commission Meeting.

rows.title: The commission awarded the Cottage Court Development to Marco Design, LLC and directed staff to find similar properties to advertise for bids.
rows.summary: Award the Cottage Court Development at 2215 E 3rd Street to Marco Design, LLC and direct staff to locate other similar properties that could be advertised for bids.

rows.title: The commission approved a ground lease with Canaan Development Group, LLC for redevelopment of city property at 1332 Martin Luther King Jr. Blvd.
rows.summary: Approval and authorization to execute a ground lease with Canaan Development Group, LLC for the redevelopment of City-owned property at 1332 Martin Luther King Jr. Blvd.

rows.title: The commission approved a contract with American Legion Post 424 for redevelopment of CRA-owned property at 1342 Martin Luther King Jr. Blvd.
rows.summary: Approval to execute the contract with American Legion Post 424 for the redevelopment of CRA-owned property located at 1342 Martin Luther King Jr. Blvd.

rows.title: Commission approved Ordinance 3313 on final reading, a temporary moratorium on large-scale data centers.
rows.summary: Approval of Ordinance 3313, an ordinance adopting a temporary moratorium on large-scale data centers.

rows.title: Commission continued Ordinance 3315 to the October 27, 2026 meeting.
rows.summary: Continue Ordinance 3315 to the October 27, 2026, Commission Meeting.

rows.title: Commission approved the Conceptual Plan for a property on Highway 390.
rows.summary: Approval of the proposed Conceptual Plan for a property located on Highway 390 (Parcel ID 13000-000-000).

rows.title: Commission postponed the Gateway Overlay Special Exception hearing to October 27, 2026.
rows.summary: Postpone the public hearing of the proposed Gateway Overlay Special Exception to the October 27, 2026, Commission Meeting.

rows.title: Commission approved Ordinance 3312 zoning the property at 2913 E 5th Court as Neighborhood General.
rows.summary: Approval of Ordinance 3312 amending the Zoning Map to reflect a zoning designation of Neighborhood General, NG, for a property located at 2913 E 5th Court (Parcel ID 23267-000-000).

rows.title: Commission continued the suspension of Transportation Impact Fees through January 2027.
rows.summary: Approval to continue suspension of Transportation Impact Fees through January 2027.

rows.title: Commission approved engaging Emergency Medical Solutions, LLC for a Fire Department Operational Assessment.
rows.summary: Approval to engage Emergency Medical Solutions, LLC to conduct a Fire Department Operational Assessment.

rows.title: Commission declared Art Marine a nonresponsive bidder and voted to advertise the bid for the project.
rows.summary: Declare Art Marine a nonresponsive bidder and advertise bid for this project.

rows.title: Council adopted Ordinance 891 amending code enforcement on second reading.
rows.summary: Mr. Cox motioned adopting Ordinance 891.

rows.title: The board approved the school safety recommendations.
rows.summary: Motion to approve the School Safety Recommendations

rows.title: The commission directed staff to prepare a report evaluating the city pension plans.
rows.summary: Staff to prepare a report evaluating City Pension Plans, including outcomes for employees and budget, and providing avenues for evaluation including request for proposals, consultants, and employee feedback.

rows.title: The commission adopted the Parks, Culture and Recreation Capital Improvement Plan for grant applications.
rows.summary: Approval of Resolution 20261013.4 adopting the Parks, Culture and Recreation Capital Improvement Plan for the purpose of applying to grant programs for funding assistance.

rows.title: The commission directed staff to present multiple properties and next steps at a Virtual Workshop.
rows.summary: Direct staff to present multiple properties and information on the next steps for this type of development at a Virtual Workshop.

rows.title: The commission voted to add affordability as a requirement to upcoming property advertisements.
rows.summary: Add affordability as a requirement to the upcoming property advertisements.

rows.title: The commission ratified Resolution 20261013.6 extending the local state of emergency.
rows.summary: Approval of Ratification of Resolution 20261013.6 Extending the State of Emergency due to Hurricane Isais.

rows.title: Commission directed staff to return within 30 days with a cost benefit analysis of three IT department options.
rows.summary: Direct staff to bring back a cost benefit analysis with three different solutions for improvement and efficiency of the Information Technology Department within 30 days.

rows.title: Commission approved the amended SHIP LHAP prepared for FHFC.
rows.summary: Approval of the amended SHIP LHAP prepared for FHFC due to SB 594 passing during the 2026 FL Legislative Session.

rows.title: Commission voted to dedicate no City dollars to these efforts and directed staff to work with Bay County on a unified strategy.
rows.summary: No dollars be dedicated to these efforts in the City and staff directed to work with Bay County to find a way to unify the strategy.

rows.title: The board approved the additional units for 2026-2027.

rows.summary: Empower the City Manager and Housing and Community Services Director to return with names to consider for the After School Assistance Program Board to the October 27, 2026, Commission Meeting.
